## Decision

The bin/ledger deprecation notice writes to stderr only and leaves the exit code and stdout untouched.

## Rationale

bin/ledger stdout is parsed by agents and its exit code is read by guards including piped-exit-code-guard. A notice on stdout or a changed exit code would be a behavior change and would violate D6.

## Alternatives Considered

- Print on stdout as a leading comment line
- Exit non-zero to force migration
